title: How to Style Oversized T-Shirts
excerpt: Learn how to style oversized T-shirts with balanced proportions, simple layers and everyday streetwear essentials.
author: CLOTH X CLUB
content: An oversized T-shirt is one of the easiest foundations for an everyday streetwear outfit. Its relaxed shape gives you room to experiment while keeping the look comfortable.
Start with proportion. Pair a roomy tee with straight-fit or relaxed trousers. If both pieces are very wide, keep the colours simple so the outfit feels intentional rather than bulky.
For an easy layered look, add an open shirt, lightweight jacket or overshirt. Finish with clean sneakers and one or two understated accessories. Let the fit do most of the work.
The best outfit is one you feel comfortable wearing. Try different combinations, keep the pieces that work for you, and make the look your own.

title: Streetwear Essentials Every Wardrobe Needs
excerpt: Build a versatile streetwear wardrobe with dependable T-shirts, relaxed bottoms, sneakers and accessories.
author: CLOTH X CLUB
content: A useful streetwear wardrobe starts with pieces you can wear in more than one way. Choose comfortable shapes, colours that work together and items that suit your everyday routine.

Begin with a few reliable tops: an oversized black tee, a clean white tee and a shirt or overshirt for layering. These pieces can work across casual outfits without requiring a complicated styling plan.
For bottoms, consider relaxed jeans or cargo pants in versatile colours. A comfortable pair of sneakers can bring the outfit together, while a cap or simple accessory adds a personal touch.
You do not need a huge wardrobe to create different looks. Start with essentials you enjoy wearing, then add statement pieces gradually.

title: Easy Colour Combinations for Everyday Outfits
excerpt: Explore simple black, white, grey, olive and denim combinations for easy everyday outfits.
author: CLOTH X CLUB
content: A simple colour palette can make getting dressed easier. Neutral shades are easy to combine and provide a useful base for everyday streetwear outfits.
Black and white create a crisp contrast. Try a black oversized tee with light trousers, or a white tee with black cargos. Keep footwear neutral to maintain a clean finish.
Grey works well with black, white and denim. Olive can add colour without making an outfit feel too loud, especially when paired with cream, charcoal or washed black.
Use these combinations as starting points rather than strict rules. Experiment with the pieces you already own and choose colours that feel right to you.
